source_snapshot.purpose_facts: The row names a PCIe Replay Number Rollover correctable RAS test on an unspecified NVIDIA CPU platform.
procedure_facts: Before-test text asks for recipe conformity and log clearing.
The entire during-test instruction is only `PCIE RAS Features - Replay Number Rollover`.
After-test text requests results/photos and review of unexpected logs.
missing_source_information: Exact NVIDIA CPU platform, PCIe hierarchy and AER ownership.
Definition of Replay Number Rollover for the selected component and how the rollover is stimulated.
Source/receiver/reporting BDF map, traffic pattern, target coverage and iteration count.
Expected AER status/counter plus whether link retraining is expected, allowed or forbidden for this platform.
Timeout, post-retrain link/device/service health, recovery, restoration and pass/fail criteria.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate reporting and platform behavior for a deliberately induced PCIe Replay Number Rollover correctable condition on an approved NVIDIA CPU PCIe hierarchy, including the signed link-retrain expectation and restored link/device function; the current row does not define the stimulus or acceptance rule.
must_preserve: Replay Number Rollover rather than Bad TLP, replay timeout or a generic correctable event.
The selected NVIDIA CPU platform and exact PCIe hierarchy after owner definition.
must_not_infer: That the previous Bad TLP stimulus or evidence is applicable.
That a GPU-specific replay rollover definition or counter applies to a CPU Root Complex, NIC, switch or other endpoint.
That link retraining is automatically a failure merely because generic correctable AER often requires no recovery, or automatically a pass because one NVIDIA GPU metric describes retraining.
A generator, BDF locus, traffic volume, rollover threshold, coverage or iteration count.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly keeps the label-only/TBD case BLOCKED, requires authoritative tool/topology/evidence and limits the Agent to read-only baselines.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 treats Replay Number Rollover like a generic correctable event and does not require an explicit retrain expectation. Official NVIDIA GPU telemetry describes replay rollover as occurring after consecutive replays and causing link retraining, while generic Linux AER classifies the counter as correctable; neither fact can be generalized to this unidentified CPU-platform hierarchy.

related_records: The adjacent Bad TLP case has different link-layer stimulus and acceptance semantics and cannot provide this rollover recipe.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The exact row fixes Replay Number Rollover and correctable classification only. The TBD Criteria and label-only procedure leave component-specific rollover and retrain behavior to the signed platform recipe.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Maintain BLOCKED. Require a component-specific replay/rollover definition, generator and source/receiver/reporter map, plus an explicit expected-retrain and post-retrain health contract; do not copy Bad TLP or impose a universal no-retrain rule.

conditions_present: Replay Number Rollover, correctable severity, NV CPU PCIe context and 10/10-minute estimates are known.
missing: Exact component/platform, replay and rollover semantics, generator/traffic pattern, BDF loci and coverage, counter/event/retrain expectation, timeout, approvals, recovery and restoration.
provider: NVIDIA/ODM FAE supplies the exact component's replay/rollover and retrain semantics plus supported stimulus.
Test owner defines target coverage, traffic/rollover criteria, event/counter acceptance and timing.
Device/network/storage owners approve traffic and link impact; lab owner provides SUT, console and recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory the complete PCIe hierarchy, BDFs, link speed/width, devices, drivers and firmware.
Read AER ownership, capabilities, correctable Replay Number Rollover counters and component-native replay/rollover telemetry when supported, without clearing/resetting counters.
Capture traffic, link, device, service, OS/BMC/firmware and health baselines and identify critical dependencies.
prohibited_until_resolved: Counter/log/status clear, AER control changes, traffic intended to force replays, injector/exerciser loading or writes, rollover stimulus, link retrain/reset, retry or PASS/FAIL claim.
closure_evidence: A signed recipe defines replay, rollover threshold/trigger and retrain behavior for the exact link components.
Every target row maps traffic origin, receiver and reporter BDF plus required coverage/iterations.
Expected fresh counter/status/event, timing, link transition and restored speed/width/device/service health rules are approved and freshly reviewed.

revision_candidate.test_name: NVIDIA CPU PCIe Replay Number Rollover Correctable Error - Definition Required
revision_candidate.purpose: After an authoritative component-specific recipe is supplied, induce one bounded PCIe Replay Number Rollover condition for every approved hierarchy target and verify the signed correctable AER/counter response, the expected link transition or retrain behavior, and restored link, device, service and system health. The current row is not executable.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Unresolved. The owner must identify the NVIDIA CPU/product, system/stepping, firmware, BIOS/BMC, OS/kernel, AER ownership, PCIe generation/topology, link components and supported internal/vendor/external rollover stimulus. GPU telemetry semantics are applicable only if the signed target is that supported NVIDIA GPU path.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Unresolved per-link hierarchy rows. Each future row must bind traffic origin, transmitting/receiving components, AER reporting Root Port/RCEC or component, all BDFs, link role, supported replay/rollover telemetry and required iterations. The row does not authorize representative or all-slot coverage. Treat 10/10 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Exact platform/link topology and OS-versus-firmware AER ownership; authoritative NVIDIA/ODM/PCIe replay-rollover recipe; generator/tool/exerciser version/hash and execution location; source/receiver/reporter BDF map and coverage; controlled traffic; rollover threshold/trigger and exact stimulus; correctable status, source identity and counter delta; component-native replay/rollover telemetry; expected retrain/link-state sequence; mask/ratelimit/freshness/timeout; restored speed/width/enumeration/function/service health; baseline/clear policy; approvals; recovery/restoration.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: No rollover stimulus is authorized while Criteria is TBD and Procedure is label-only. Perform non-mutating topology, AER ownership/capability, replay/rollover counter, link and service baselines only. After the owner supplies the complete recipe, submit it for fresh V3 review; only that contract may define one bounded traffic/stimulus sequence, expected link transition, evidence correlation, recovery and restoration.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Signed replacement Procedure/Criteria; exact platform/link components, replay/rollover semantics, generator, loci, traffic, coverage, counter/event and retrain expectation resolved; dedicated non-production SUT; affected traffic/devices controlled; stable link/device/system baseline; console/OOB and recovery proven; every clear, configuration, stimulus, retrain/reset, retry and restoration action approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Before authorization: signed platform/topology/tool/stimulus/retrain/evidence/safety/recovery contract. A future reviewed run requires identities/hashes; per-row component/BDF map; baseline AER and native replay/rollover counters; link state/speed/width and traffic; mask/status/counter clear audit; exact stimulus/transcript; fresh target-correlated Replay Number Rollover correctable status/event and prescribed counter delta within timeout; timestamped expected link transition/retrain if required; restored negotiated speed/width, enumeration, device/traffic/service/system health; anomalies, recovery, restoration and engineer disposition. BMC/BERT evidence is conditional on the recipe.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Not yet defined. The signed NVIDIA/ODM component recipe and applicable PCIe AER definition must specify rollover and retrain behavior. Linux exposes Replay Number Rollover among correctable AER counters; NVIDIA GPU documentation describes its GPU metric as a rollover after consecutive replays that retrains the link. These sources do not establish behavior for an unidentified NV CPU PCIe target.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not reuse Bad TLP stimulus, infer replay threshold or BDF loci, transfer GPU semantics to another component, assume retrain is universally required or forbidden, select an injector/exerciser by analogy, clear/reset counters, force production/boot/storage/network/management traffic, inject, auto-loop/retry, retrain/reset or claim PASS/FAIL before fresh review. Stop on wrong counter/locus/severity, unexpected link transition, failed speed/width restoration, device loss, error storm or service impact.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: NVIDIA/ODM FAE and test owner approve component-specific replay/rollover/retrain semantics, generator, topology rows, traffic and acceptance. Device/network/storage owners approve target isolation; lab owner approves SUT and recovery; a fresh reviewer approves the executable contract. Qualified staff authorize and supervise each later stimulus and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Before re-review, an Agent may only collect non-mutating topology, AER/native counters, link and service baselines. Humans own recipe creation, physical/external exerciser work, target/traffic selection, counter-clear policy, stimulus authorization and recovery. The future contract defines Agent execution; engineering retains disposition.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No recovery is authorized by the current row because no stimulus is authorized. Preserve accidental-change evidence, stop affected traffic and escalate. The replacement recipe must define expected versus unexpected retrain, link/device loss and host recovery, counter/control restoration and final speed/width/device/service health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Criteria remains TBD or procedure label-only; platform/link components/AER ownership/replay-rollover semantics/generator/locus/traffic/coverage/counter/event/retrain expectation/timeout is unresolved; only generic or mismatched GPU documentation exists; approval, SUT, isolation, baseline, console, recovery, storage or restoration is missing; topology/capability mismatches the recipe; or any unreviewed clear, traffic stimulus, injection, retrain/reset or retry is proposed.

identified_defects: Criteria are TBD and Procedure is only a Replay Number Rollover label.
No component-specific replay/rollover definition, generator, traffic pattern, hierarchy map or coverage exists.
V2 omits the expected-versus-unexpected link retrain decision unique to this error.
V2 generically lists BERT/SEL without making them platform-conditional.
reason_for_change: Preserve this rollover-specific correctable test without cloning the Bad TLP case, and force the owner to define whether retraining is the expected mechanism and how the link must recover before an Agent can execute it.

Makes the reporting counter/component and BDF loci explicit future inputs.
Requires a signed decision on expected retrain rather than imposing the generic correctable no-reset rule.

objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains the justified BLOCKED result while adding the error-specific replay counter and expected-retrain contract, preventing the adjacent Bad TLP logic or GPU-only semantics from being reused blindly.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract-only validator kept rollover distinct from Bad TLP, mapped transmitter/receiver/reporter loci separately, and refused to transfer GPU semantics or decide retrain behavior. It required a signed per-component transition rule and rejected a counter, AER bit, retrain or restored link alone as completion.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly blocks execution but does not define the rollover-specific counter or resolve whether retraining is expected for the selected components.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow non-mutating topology, replay/rollover counter and link-health baselines only; prohibit traffic stimulus, clear, injection or retrain until component semantics, expected transition, approvals and recovery pass fresh review.
